args.title: Validate calendar-correctness of report date fields
args.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

The `isoDate` zod schema only checks the YYYY-MM-DD shape with a regex, so impossible dates like "2027-02-29" or "2026-04-31" pass validation and are sent straight to Postgres, which raises a 500 ("date/time field value out of range"). Add a calendar-validity check (e.g. parse the date and confirm the round-tripped components match) to `isoDate` so invalid dates fail Zod validation and the API returns a 400 naming the field instead.

label: bug
file: src/api/reports.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The `isoDate` schema in src/api/reports.ts only regex-checks the YYYY-MM-DD shape, so calendar-invalid dates like "2027-02-29" or "2026-04-31" pass validation and reach `reportRepo.create`'s INSERT as raw strings, where Postgres throws and the unhandled DatabaseError becomes a 500. The fix is to make `isoDate` also verify the date is a real calendar date (e.g. round-trip it through Date and compare year/month/day) so Zod rejects it with a 400 naming the field before it ever reaches the database.
